notes: Icons on everything: the picture puller no longer skips big apps (WhatsApp, Spotify, Amazon, ChatGPT class), prefers a real PNG picture wherever the app carries one, and our own shop apps (com.ifixxrepairs.*) are recognized as ours — never flagged by the sideload rule and labeled (our app).
